items.name: Truffle Parmesan Hand-Cut Fries
items.description: Crispy Idaho potatoes tossed in white truffle essence, sea salt flakes, and aged Parmigiano-Reggiano, served with roasted garlic aioli.

items.name: Avocado Heirloom Bruschetta
items.description: Grilled artisan sourdough rubbed with garlic, crushed Hass avocado, marinated San Marzano cherry tomatoes, and aged balsamic glaze.

items.name: Paneer Tikka Angara
items.description: Charcoal-roasted cottage cheese cubes infused with Kashmiri degi mirch, bell peppers, mint relish, and house tandoori masala.

items.name: Crispy Golden Calamari Fritti
items.description: Tender squid rings flashed in seasoned sea-salt batter, dusted with smoked sweet paprika, accompanied by preserved lemon tartare sauce.

items.name: Korean Honey Gochujang Wings
items.description: Twice-crisped chicken wings tossed in fermented Korean chili glaze, wild honey, and toasted white sesame seeds.

items.name: Classic Margherita Di Bufala
items.description: Sweet San Marzano D.O.P. tomato sauce, fresh buffalo mozzarella, hand-torn basil leaves, and a drizzle of cold-pressed EVOO.

items.name: Truffle & Forest Mushroom
items.description: Roasted shiitake and cremini mushrooms, fior di latte mozzarella, caramelized shallots, fresh thyme, and white truffle drizzle.

items.name: Fiery Peri-Peri Paneer & Bell Pepper
items.description: Spiced cottage cheese cubes, charred red and yellow peppers, pickled red onions, jalapenos, and smoked scamorza cheese.

items.name: Smoked Hickory BBQ Chicken Pizza
items.description: Wood-smoked chicken breast shreds, sweet bourbon BBQ reduction, mozzarella, red onions, fresh coriander, and crisp bacon crumbs.

items.name: Artisan Fettuccine Alfredo
items.description: Fresh bronze-cut fettuccine tossed in 24-month aged parmesan cream sauce, cracked Telicherry pepper, and fresh nutmeg.

items.name: Rigatoni Alla Vodka with Burrata
items.description: Slow-simmered Calabrian tomato vodka cream sauce clinging to rigatoni, topped with a whole creamy pugliese burrata ball.

items.name: Smoked Butter Chicken Gourmet Bowl
items.description: Clay-oven succulent chicken in velvet tomato & makhani cream gravy, served alongside buttery garlic naan crisps and saffron pulao.

items.name: 24-Hour Slow-Cooked Dal Makhani
items.description: Organic black urad lentils gently simmered over smoldering coals for 24 hours with country butter and dairy cream, served with kulcha.

items.name: The Wagyu-Style Smash Cheeseburger
items.description: Double seared prime patty, gooey American cheddar, secret bistro sauce, pickles, and butter-toasted brioche bun with crispy onion rings.

items.name: Sparkling Passionfruit & Mint Cooler
items.description: Sun-ripened passionfruit pulp, muddled spearmint, Sicilian lime juice, sparkling botanical tonic water, and crushed crystal ice.

items.name: Cold Brew Citrus Tonic
items.description: 16-hour steeped single-origin Arabica cold brew poured over Mediterranean tonic and garnished with a torched blood-orange wheel.

items.name: Wild Blackberry Mojito
items.description: Crushed forest blackberries, fresh garden mint, raw demerara cane sugar, sparkling soda, and key lime twist.

items.name: Belgian Dark Iced Chocolate
items.description: 70% pure Callebaut Belgian dark chocolate ganache shaken with whole chilled milk and crowned with bittersweet cocoa dusting.

items.name: Classic Venetian Tiramisu
items.description: Layered savoiardi dipped in espresso and mascarpone

items.name: Molten Belgian Chocolate Lava Cake
items.description: Warm chocolate sponge with an oozing warm chocolate center, accompanied by Madagascar vanilla bean gelato and fresh berries.

items.name: New York Baked Cheesecake with Strawberry Coulis
items.description: Rich and velvety Philadelphia cream cheese cake on a golden buttery graham cracker crust, topped with fresh strawberry compote.

items.name: Ethiopian Yirgacheffe V60 Pour-Over
items.description: Light roast single-origin specialty beans with notes of jasmine, bergamot, and sweet peach blossom, brewed freshly table-side.

items.name: Spanish Cortado with Oat Milk
items.description: Double ristretto espresso cut with an equal part of steamed silky Minor Figures barista oat milk.

items.name: Pure Butter Laminated Croissant
items.description: Baked fresh every morning with French Normandy cultured butter. 32 delicate layers resulting in a honeycomb crumb and golden shatter crust.

items.name: Truffled Wild Mushroom Tartine
items.description: House-fermented toasted sourdough loaf slice, cremini and porcini sauteed in garlic butter, whipped ricotta, and micro-herbs.

items.name: Crispy Truffle Croquettes (Postman Test)
items.description: Golden croquettes stuffed with fontina cheese and black truffle reduction.

items.name: Senior Consultant Physician Consultation (OPD)
items.description: Comprehensive physical examination, diagnosis of symptoms, vitals check, medical history review, and personalized prescription slip.

items.name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with ESR (28 Parameters)
items.description: Measures RBC, WBC, Hemoglobin, Platelet count, Hematocrit, and Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate. Digital report delivered in 2 hours via SMS/WhatsApp.

items.name: Comprehensive Executive Health Checkup (64 Tests)
items.description: Complete metabolic panel including Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Fasting Blood Sugar, HbA1c, and Vitamin D3/B12.

items.name: Targeted Spine & Neck Physiotherapy Session (45m)
items.description: Postural assessment, deep tissue neuromuscular mobilization, ultrasound therapy, and guided rehabilitative strengthening exercises.

items.name: Single Day All-Access Workout Pass
items.description: Full day access to weight training floor, cardio deck, locker facilities, steam room, and functional turf area. Includes complimentary towel service.

items.name: Gold Whey Isolate Shake (32g Protein, Peanut Banana)
items.description: Pure cold-filtered whey isolate blended with almond milk, creamy organic peanut butter, fresh banana, oats, and chia seeds. Zero added sugar.

items.name: BCAA Electrolyte Hydration Cooler (Watermelon Slush)
items.description: Fermented vegan BCAAs (2:1:1 ratio) infused with Himalayan pink salt electrolytes, organic coconut water base, and crushed ice.

items.name: 1-on-1 HIIT & Power Strength Coaching (60 min)
items.description: Personalized training session with a certified CSCS trainer focusing on barbell compound movements, kettlebell conditioning, and form correction.
